roleInfo.name: Red Bard
roleInfo.description: You're the Red Clan's Bard — grunt small words!

roleInfo.name: Blue Bard
roleInfo.description: You're the Blue Clan's Bard — grunt small words!

Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) — in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your clan how to play this game!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.gruntIsBestWith: Grunt is best with 4+ players. We'll play with what we have, but feel free to grab a friend.
Default.twoClansEachTurn:
Two clans. Each turn, one player on the active clan is the Bard. The Bard gets an easy card and a hard card, and picks which word to describe — using only one-syllable words (yes, really).

Teammates shout out guesses. The Bard taps the card their clan guesses to score it (the other card is skipped), or taps Pass to skip both for –1.
Default.easyCards1Point:
Easy cards = 1 point. Hard cards = 3 points. Pass = –1. The Bard has 90 seconds per turn — burn through as many as you can.

If the other clan hears a multi-syllable word, they yell "BAD!" — honor system, the Bard should pass that card.

After both clans take a turn, the host picks: keep playing, reset scores, or end the game.
Default.clanWhoWantsTo: ($1) clan: who wants to be Bard this turn?
Default.youReTheBard: ($1), you're the Bard. Use only one-syllable words. Your clan shouts guesses! ($2)s on the clock.
Default.clickTheCardIf: ($1), tap the card your clan guessed — the other gets skipped — or hit Pass to skip both for –1!
Default.clickTheDecks: ($1), click the Easy and Hard deck when your clan is done reviewing the round.
